theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Materials (+1.47%) and Consumer Staples (+1.01%) led the market today, while Financials (-1.84%) and Communication Svcs (-1.06%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.16%, defensives +0.41%, and value/cyclicals -0.29% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.00%, Dow -0.36%, Nasdaq +0.45% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up +0.51%, outperforming large caps. The VIX fell 4.37% to 14.21, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 0.48% to $4,400.00, crude oil was little changed at $89.66, and bitcoin slipped 0.31% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
